mentions.name: simd_explorer
mentions.description: A TUI app for interactively running different SIMD instructions and seeing their outputs, usable as an interactive quick reference guide for SIMD instructions. It supports AVX/AVX2, works on Windows and Linux, and with the right environment variables can run as AMD64 on an Apple M chip; Arm NEON instructions are not supported.

mentions.name: simd_explorer
mentions.description: A TUI tool that demonstrates the behavior of X86 SIMD (AVX/AVX2) instructions, implemented in Go assembly. Users set inputs for a SIMD instruction and read the resulting outputs to understand how each instruction works; it is intended to support text processing work and studying code that uses SIMD.
mentions.problem: Reading and understanding a swiss map implementation was difficult because the SIMD instructions were challenging to grasp and the documentation felt hard to read; an interactive tool for setting inputs and reading outputs made understanding the instructions much easier.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on a TUI tool which demonstrates the behaviour of X86 SIMD instructions. This is all done in Go assembly, and is probably most valuable for Go programmers.
